text_block_list.text:
Our first three years in the Twinkle 
Series with Mejiro Bright came to a close.

Yet the races continued unabated. And amid 
those days, stepping up to announce 
herself as the greatest rival was—

It was neither Mejiro McQueen nor Silence 
Suzuka, but an unexpected Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work, Bright-san! 
Thanks for everything today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good work~, Spe-sama. It looks like it was 
another one-two finish for the both of 
us~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to think Spe-sama would enter so 
many long-distance races like this~"

—Special Week. The speed of her final 
spurt is far beyond anyone else's in the 
new generation.

"I thought you would place more emphasis 
on medium distances, but..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Umm, the-the truth is, Bright-san...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I really respect you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huh, Spe-sama...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I really respect her— Bright-san of the 
Mejiro family! When we ran together, I 
thought she was just incredible.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how long the distance is, I 
give it my all on the final stretch! Plus, 
our family home is the finest in all of 
Japan!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I don't know much about stayers and all 
that, but... long distances sure are 
great!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run my absolute best in 
long-distance races, just like Bright-san 
does!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, Spe-sama, thank you very much~.

Special Week came to admire Mejiro Bright, 
following her around both on and off the 
racetrack.

Mejiro Bright gladly welcomed Special Week 
as well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Spe-sama, why don't we take a short break 
and have a snack~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I have brought along some wonderfully 
sweet scones today~. To enjoy together 
with some chamomile tea~."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, down the hatch! The snacks from the 
Mejiro estate are always so delicious, 
aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I could eat this every day, that would 
be so fun~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine~. You can come stay over 
anytime~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really!? In that case, next time...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan...? Why... are you with 
Bright...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Suzuka-san! Bright-san has been 
teaching me all sorts of things lately!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
They were so kind, it was such a big help! 
As expected of your friend, Suzuka-san.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bright... I'm not quite sure how to 
put it, but, well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Cannot lose?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Howaa...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just because...

A faint emotion flickered to the surface. 
Yet, lost in the sheer denseness of both 
parties, it was washed away, and then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Bright-san. Nyan nyan♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Nyan nyan, Lady Sky~.

Another one has arrived: Seiun Sky. A 
fellow classmate of Special Week's and a 
cunning front-runner, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Bright-san. That race the other 
day was quite interesting, wasn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She always makes a late charge no matter 
what, so it gives me plenty to read into, 
in a sense.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, they completely got the better of me 
at the very end, though. Tee-hee♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was just a li~ttle bit lucky back then, 
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, stop being so modest~. Besides, 
Bright-san's charm isn't limited to just 
her late-race sprint."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Her hair is so soft and fluffy. When we 
nap together, it feels kind of like 
heaven.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"So whenever I have some free time like 
this, I can't help dropping by every now 
and then."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, I am delighted, Lady Sky. To think I 
could make so many close friends outside 
of the Mejiro family~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to staying close with you 
from now on as well.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yes, most certainly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please take good care of us, Trainer! 
Bright-san is our role model, after all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Or if you want, you could take care of all 
of us together~? Meow meow♪

Mejiro Bright's easygoing personality is 
gradually wrapping around everyone, even 
outside the Mejiro family.

"And at the same time, her stayers' rivals 
multiply. Through Bright, the Mejiro 
policy is bound to leave its mark on the 
Umamusume world."
